overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a robust social media presence across academic and professional networks, totaling 3,580 followers across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon. His content is highly specialized, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated behavior. Engagement is strong across all channels, driven heavily by research milestones, software tool releases, and academic recruitment opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Methodological discussions, tool updates (e.g., CooRnet v2.0), and research focused on identifying coordinated sharing patterns.
Recruiting postdoctoral researchers and PhD students for computational social science projects.
Sharing newly published papers, conference presentations, and newly awarded research grants.

recommendations: Increase publishing frequency on LinkedIn to better leverage its large follower base (1,850 followers) for professional announcements.
Utilize rich media and direct links to publications and job applications across Bluesky and Mastodon to capitalize on high user engagement.
Leverage popular hashtags on Bluesky and Mastodon to expand reach beyond the immediate follower base into broader academic and data science communities.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky yields the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), characterized by a strong ratio of reposts. It serves as an excellent channel for peer-to-peer amplification of papers and opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a highly targeted, niche audience (4.55% average engagement rate) that responds well to technical development updates, such as CooRnet software releases.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest audience size (1,850 followers) and generates the highest absolute engagement. It is highly effective for high-impact professional updates, such as funding awards and postdoc hiring.
